title: NAS key set identifier information element

fields.name: NAS key set identifier IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for NAS key set identifier

fields.name: TSC
fields.description: Type of security context flag: Bit 4 = 0 for native security context (for KSIasme or KSIamf), Bit 4 = 1 for mapped security context (for KSIsgsn or KSIamf). TSC does not apply for NAS key set identifier value '111'.

fields.name: NAS key set identifier
fields.description: NAS key set identifier value. Bits 3-2-1: 000 through 110 are possible values for the NAS key set identifier; 111 = no key is available (UE to network); reserved (network to UE)

notes: The NAS key set identifier is allocated by the network.
The NAS key set identifier is a type 1 information element.
TSC does not apply for NAS key set identifier value '111'.
